svg.text: Reference strings citing K. G. Wilson, Phys. Rev. D 10, 2445 (1974), as they stand in the citing manuscripts. INSPIRE-HEP, 10 August 2026.
Each hair is one citation, in rank order by the year of the citing record — the record is dominated by recent papers. Tall marks deviate.
An arc joins two papers that print the same wrong digits — the trace of a copy. Red: different authors. Grey: one author group repeating itself.
1. citing record of 1978 · gives year “1975” · INSPIRE 2173044 — repeated
2. citing record of 1979 · gives year “1975” · INSPIRE 144427 — repeated
3. citing record of 1990 · gives volume “IO” · INSPIRE 1835048
4. citing record of 2017 · gives volume “46” · INSPIRE 1765257
5. citing record of 2021 · gives volume “19” · INSPIRE 1980647
6. citing record of 2024 · gives year “1975” · INSPIRE 2767189 — repeated
7. citing record of 2025 · gives volume “80” · INSPIRE 2939843 — repeated
8. citing record of 2025 · gives volume “80” · INSPIRE 3064036 — repeated
Share of citations to this paper carrying a misprint
2002 · 2,578 citations, ISI (Simkin & Roychowdhury, Table I.2, row 4)
The two bars are not the same corpus and not the same instrument: the 2002 row counts every indexed citation, this one counts only
the references whose original text survives in the database. What the comparison can carry is argued in work.md, not here.
